It is best known for developing Claude, a family of AI models that competes with OpenAI’s ChatGPT.

stories.title: Can sound heal? A workshop tries to find the answer
stories.summary: In a city that runs on notifications, a one-day workshop is asking people to do something increasingly unfamiliar: sit still and listen. Naad means sound, while yoga refers to union or discipline. The tradition of Naad Yoga holds that consciously engaging with sound can help bring a restless mind into balance.

stories.title: Is Your Trading App Making You Lose Money? | Pocket Money
stories.summary: Investing has never been easier. However, research indicates that effortless, on-tap investing on mobile apps also makes it easier to lose money. How many times have you checked your stock portfolio today? Once? Five times? Ten times? And when you see a stock rising or falling, do you feel the urge to do something — buy more, sell, or perhaps find another stock to invest in?

stories.title: Karthigai Deepam row: The century-old dispute over a hill in Tamil Nadu, explained
stories.summary: This is the latest legal chapter in the century-old property disagreement tied to the site. Here’s how the dispute originated, shaped decades of worship at the site, and resurfaced in December last year. Thiruparankundram hill rises about 1050 feet on the outskirts of Madurai. At its base stands the Arulmigu Subramanian Swamy Cave Temple, associated with Hindu worship for centuries.

stories.title: Everyday Explained: Why your eyes twitch randomly throughout the day
stories.summary: Have you ever noticed your eyelid suddenly twitching while working, scrolling through your phone, or simply going about your day? The involuntary movement can last a few seconds or keep coming back throughout the day, often without an obvious reason. In this edition of ‘Everyday Explained,’ HT lifestyle spoke to Dr Madhura M, consultant retina, cataract and refractive surgeon at Vasan Eye Care, Jayanagar, to understand the reason behind this.

stories.title: How much money does the UK government borrow, and why does it matter?
stories.summary: To fill this gap it borrows money, but that has to be paid back - with interest. The government gets most of its income from taxes. For example, workers pay income tax and National Insurance , everyone pays VAT on certain goods, and companies pay tax on profits.

stories.title: Wedding season begins with Dev Uthani Ekadashi: How are gifts from in-laws taxed before and after marriage? Explained
stories.summary: Today marks the beginning of the Hindu wedding season with Dev Uthani Ekadashi, which means the “awakening of the deity” and marks the end of the four-month Chaturmas period, when Lord Vishnu is believed to wake from his Yoga Nidra. With the 2026 wedding season beginning on 20 November, families and in-laws also exchange gifts in the form of cash, jewellery and other valuables.

stories.title: EXPLAINED: Major overhaul of PF withdrawals
stories.summary: The decisions were taken at the 240th meeting of the Central Board of Trustees (CBT), chaired by Union Labour and Employment Minister Mansukh Mandaviya on November 19. Here is an explainer on the changes approved. Retirees can opt for taking their PF savings as monthly, quarterly, or half-yearly payouts instead of withdrawing the whole corpus at once as a lump sum.

stories.title: Why is PM Modi upset with corporate India? | Explained
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi recently used his address to a hall full of India’s top corporate leaders to castigate them on a variety of issues affecting the Indian economy. Several of these concerns have been raised by the Opposition in the past as well, but the Prime Minister’s acknowledgement lends greater weight to these issues.

stories.title: Why is the internet making Batman edits to Madhuri Dixit's iconic Sajan Sajan song?
stories.summary: Well, let's take a little detour into how Gotham's most unexpected Bollywood crossover came to be. The trend can be traced back to a series of AI-generated videos by Bengaluru-based creator Sujal Jaiswar, who gave the Dark Knight a distinctly desi makeover. Jaiswar, who works as an AI generalist at House Of Edtech, began sharing videos from his ‘Desi Batman’ series, placing the superhero in familiar Indian settings.

stories.title: The hidden cost of handing smartphone to a child | Explained
stories.summary: As toddlers swiping through smartphone screens before holding a pencil has become a common sight, paediatricians are worried about an alarming trend: smartphones being increasingly used as “digital pacifiers” to appease toddlers during mealtime, soothe them when they throw a tantrum and keep them engaged while managing household chores.

stories.title: How do autistic people parse information? A video game can help say
stories.summary: Researchers have developed a non-verbal online game that adolescents across the autism spectrum can learn and play; it holds special promise for India by bypassing the need to translate complex clinical instructions into regional languages and allowing clinicians to reach autistic individuals far beyond the major metros

stories.title: Charlie Puth And Ellie Goulding To Perform In India For The First Time At Mumbai Music Festival; Details In
stories.summary: Mumbai, get ready to sing your heart out! If you've ever belted out the lyrics of Attention , We Don't Talk Anymore or Love Me Like You Do , there's some exciting news coming your way. International pop stars Charlie Puth and Ellie Goulding are finally bringing their music to India, and their first-ever performances in the country will take place in Mumbai in February 2027.

stories.title: HC quashes cheating case against builder Akhtar Rizvi, family
stories.summary: The Bombay High Court on Wednesday quashed a cheating case against former MP and Mumbai builder Akhtar Hasan Rizvi, his daughter Meena Rizvi and former wife Reshma Rizvi, ruling that a business dispute had been wrongly turned into a criminal case to pressure them into a settlement

stories.title: Maharashtra: MSRTC deploys 1,000 additional buses for Kartiki Ekadashi
stories.summary: The Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation (MSRTC) has kept around 1,000 additional buses ready to ferry devotees to Pandharpur for the Kartiki Ekadashi pilgrimage on November 21. With lakhs of Warkaris expected to visit the temple town to seek the blessings of Lord Vitthal, MSRTC focuses on assuring proper facilities to pilgrims.
